cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd take over the wedding arrivals. Start by phoning the guests who haven't replied to our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door on the day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You need to know who's coming to it. Use this list and mark their answers beside their names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to let people in, not chase them beforehand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make these the calls that let them in without confusion. I have your name against arrivals already; tell me when you've finished the list.

reason: Make A and B wedding hosts chasing missing RSVPs, with A treating B door offer as already covering arrival preparation; no implication hosts answer their own invitations.
